items: Local SEO puts your restaurant in front of nearby guests who are already searching for a place to eat, through the map pack, AI Overviews and organic results.

Your Google Business Profile matters most: complete every field, keep your name, address and phone number consistent everywhere, choose accurate categories, add your menu and photos, and keep hours current.
Ask for Google reviews consistently right after a great meal, and reply to both positive and negative reviews with short, specific, conversational responses.
If you have several locations, give each one its own landing page with unique content and link each Google profile to it.
Earn local backlinks from directories, food bloggers and local media rather than buying them, then track your rankings and profile activity to see what's working.
